tab_single_agent

**Table: tab_single_agent.** Single-model baselines and the multi-agent systems on the locked tests (MedQA 500, MMLU-Pro 500 (test pool), GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254). Acc. and Valid are percentages; Budget = generation budget in tokens; Tokens = prefill + output per question (for systems: manager and advisors). Letter-only rows must answer with the choice letter only (no reasoning); a forced choice over the option letters backs up unparsed outputs and was never needed. Valid = share of questions with a parseable answer. No-tools rows run the manager prompt with the tools removed (DRAFT then ANSWER, no advisor calls). Multi-agent rows are the v3+GRPO round-3 systems. Where the v3+GRPO run has no token count, S₁ + advisors uses the v3-chain run of the same S₁ checkpoint (MMLU-Pro and AQuA-RAT) and RSI success uses the v1 success runs, which use the same labelling rule and call an advisor on 93–100% of questions (MedQA, MMLU-Pro and AQuA-RAT). Bold: best accuracy per benchmark within each block.

tab_replay

**Table: Matched-budget replay (appendix).** Matched-budget replay on the development pools (MedQA 200, MMLU-Pro 200, GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254). For each policy, the questions on which it made its first advisor call are rescored with the forced-call result of that advisor on the same question, and the other questions are scored with the direct answer; this gives the replay accuracy (%). Calls (E/R/V): the number of first calls the policy made to the Extractor, Reasoner and Verifier. The same number of calls per advisor is then reassigned to uniformly random questions 2,000 times; Random 95% is the 2.5–97.5 percentile interval of the resulting accuracies, p the fraction of the 2,000 random assignments whose accuracy is at least the policy's replay accuracy, and Above whether the replay accuracy exceeds the upper end of the interval. Bold: replay accuracy above the interval. R3/R5: round 3 or 5 of the chain; no GRPO: the v3 chain trained with SFT only; +GRPO: the main v3+GRPO chain. †: taken from the results page because the per-question files of these runs were not archived, so their per-advisor call counts are unavailable (—), and for the AQuA-RAT round-5 policies only p and the above/below outcome were recorded.

tab_setup

**Table: Experimental setup. S_1 is the paper's one-round SFT manager; S_k and G_k are the round-k manager before and after FA-GRPO. The GPQA sequence-length override accommodates its longer depth-2 label rows. The MMLU-Pro *test_paper* pool overlaps training pools and is used only in the appendix.**

ComponentSetting
**Models**
Base modelQwen3.5-9B (non-thinking; enable_thinking=False everywhere)
Advisorsbase model + role prompts (Extractor, Reasoner, Verifier), served with vLLM, outputs cached
ManagerLoRA on Qwen3.5-9B; S_1 = the paper's one-round SFT manager
**Rounds and data collection**
Rounds3 (each: collect, SFT, FA-GRPO); rounds 4–5 for the no-GRPO v3 chain (MedQA, MMLU-Pro, AQuA)
Questions collected per round400 (GPQA reuses its 200 round-1 roots)
Max depth2
Commit:rescue balancing ρMedQA 3.0, MMLU-Pro 2.0, GPQA 2.0, AQuA-RAT 1.0
**SFT (each round)**
Epochs3
Learning rate1e-5
Batch1 per device × 8 gradient-accumulation steps (effective 8)
Max sequence length4,096 tokens (GPQA 16,384)
Seed / context / draft supervision42 / paper (tool schemas rendered as in the S_1 prompt) / none (route-only loss)
**FA-GRPO (each round)**
Steps64 steps × 4 questions per step (256 questions per round; GPQA pool 146)
Learning rate / max grad norm / seed5e-6 / 1.0 / 0
β (root / dec / rev)0.1 / 0.1 / 0.02
Anchor λ0.03 (4 anchor rows per step); estimator: exact
Guardevery 8 steps on a 64-question probe: call-rate delta ≤ 0.10 and KL_dec ≤ 0.05, otherwise roll back to the last good step
Informative fraction≥ 0.15 of revision states with J ∈ (0.02, 0.98)
**Acceptance and gates**
GRPO acceptancedev acc ≥ S_k − 1 pt; calls ≤ S_k + 0.15; call gap ≥ 0.5 × S_k gap; ≥ 15% informative revision states (J ∈ (0.02, 0.98)); else G_k := S_k
Gatesaccuracy tolerance 0.01; extra calls 0.15; gap fraction 0.5; SFT max calls 1.5; SFT max accuracy drop 0.03
**Pools**
DevelopmentMedQA 200, MMLU-Pro 200, GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254
Locked testMedQA 500, MMLU-Pro 500 (pool test), GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254
**Arms**
dynamicre-collect with G_{k-1} each round, marginal-value labels, SFT from G_{k-1}, then FA-GRPO
staticreuse S_1's labels every round, SFT from G_{k-1}, then FA-GRPO
successlike dynamic but any trajectory ending in a correct answer is a demonstration (shortest path not required)
**Versions**
v1paper SFT target (draft letter supervised) + GRPO
v3draft letter never supervised (route-only loss), no GRPO
v3+GRPO (main)v3 loss + FA-GRPO each round

tab_grpo_log

**Table: FA-GRPO acceptance log for the v3+GRPO chains, one row per decision; round 1 is shared by the three arms. Δ columns are the candidate G_k minus the round's SFT manager S_k on the development pools (MedQA 200, MMLU-Pro 200, GPQA 100, AQuA-RAT 254): accuracy in points and calls per question. Inf.: share of revision states with J ∈ (0.02, 0.98); a stage is informative at ≥ 15%. Step: selected checkpoint / steps run (64 planned); a run with fewer steps was stopped by the guard (every 8 steps on a 64-question probe) and rolled back to the last good checkpoint, 0 being the SFT checkpoint. A candidate is rejected when its dev accuracy falls below S_k − 1 pt, when the stage is uninformative, or when its dev evaluation fails the valid-answer-rate gate; a rejected round keeps G_k := S_k. Per-arm counts include the shared round-1 decision.**
